name: Thundris Windweaver
summary: In Auberdine, reports of Blackwood aggression reach the village elder. Terenthis sends you to Thundris Windweaver with news of the furbolgs’ growing hostility. Thundris seeks the cause of the corruption spreading through Darkshore.

sections.title: A Report to the Elder
sections.body: After scouting corrupted furbolg camps in Darkshore, you carry Terenthis’s report to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine. Terenthis remains in the wilds to investigate the spreading corruption. As village elder, Thundris oversees the settlement’s daily welfare and considers the spiritual and environmental dangers facing the kaldorei. Your report gives Auberdine’s leadership evidence that the furbolgs are growing more than territorial: an unnatural malice is taking hold of them.

sections.title: Corruption Along the Coast
sections.body: Thundris has heard of rising hostility from the forest dwellers near Auberdine. The furbolgs’ aggression is not the only concern. Corruption is spreading through Darkshore’s soil, plants, and waters. Thundris believes the land cannot be healed until the source of the blight is found. He turns to the waterways and enlists capable allies to trace the taint upstream.

faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver leads Auberdine as its elder, overseeing the town’s governance and daily affairs. He works with sentinels and druids to understand and fight the corruption spreading through Darkshore.

faq.q: Why does Terenthis send you to Thundris?
faq.answer: Terenthis sends you to brief Auberdine’s leadership after you scout the Blackwood furbolg camps. Thundris Windweaver has theories about the madness affecting the wildlife and furbolgs, and needs firsthand news to coordinate a response.

faq.q: What is happening to the furbolgs in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Darkshore’s furbolgs have grown increasingly violent as corruption warps the forest. Their hostility comes from a taint poisoning the land, not merely from disputes over territory.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Elder Windweaver suspects Darkshore’s waters may carry the source of the rot. He sends you to sample the Cliffspring River and find where the contamination begins.

angles.text: Auberdine is the kaldorei’s primary port and foothold on the mainland coast. Bringing news to Elder Windweaver supports your people’s effort to preserve their sacred wilderness.
The rapid corruption of local furbolgs and forest dwellers signals a severe ecological imbalance. Cenarion allies and village elders cannot ignore it.
Keeping Auberdine safe from hostile woodland tribes protects Alliance supply lines and travelers crossing between Kalimdor and Teldrassil.
